question: Will the 12-month change in the U.S. Producer Price Index for all commodities (not seasonally adjusted; computed from the index) for August 2025 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2025-08-14) be above 3.75%?

rule.threshold_basis: a round number near the upper quartile of historical moves over the same distance

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
